text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
So there's this girl who just lost a<n>race, and she's
here at school<n>today...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I wonder, what sort of gesture would<n>make her feel
better?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know. In the language of<n>flowers, chamomile
symbolizes<n>"energy in adversity," so...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Tomorrow, I think I'll make some<n>chamomile tea for
her. I hope it'll help<n>cheer her up!
